purpose: Primary-source boundary for a possible all-order cubic string obstruction

sources.author: Tetsuji Miwa
sources.title: Painleve Property of Monodromy Preserving Deformation Equations and the Analyticity of tau Functions
exact_locations: Theorem 1, printed page 708; start of its Fredholm proof, printed pages 709-714
sources.actual_statement: The inverse monodromy-data map is meromorphic on its defined data space; the corresponding normalized solutions are meromorphic away from fixed singularity hyperplanes.
sources.essential_hypotheses: Distinct leading irregular eigenvalues; regular singular exponents distinct modulo integers in equation (2.22).
sources.application_boundary: The artificial regular singularity after cubic ramification/shearing is resonant, so the exact stated Miwa theorem cannot be applied directly without a new admission or replacement argument.

sources.author: Bernard Malgrange
sources.title: Sur les deformations isomonodromiques. II. Singularites irregulieres
exact_locations: Condition (1.2) and its r=0 exception, printed page 2 (PDF page 3)
Meromorphic connection trivialization conclusion, printed page 10 (PDF page 11)
sources.actual_statement: Universal integrable connection exists with the stated noncoalescing irregular leading type and logarithmic finite poles. For a trivial initial bundle the connection form in the constructed trivialization is meromorphic in parameters, outside/through the bundle's exceptional divisor.
sources.essential_hypotheses: Distinct irregular leading eigenvalues when r>=1; logarithmic regular poles are permitted without the additional eigenvalue nonresonance condition. The exposition writes the explicit universal parameter formulas for rank-one irregular poles and states higher irregular order analogues.
sources.application_boundary: Question (3.2) explicitly separates meromorphic connection families from meromorphic generalized Schlesinger coordinates in the resonant case. No direct meromorphic scalar-coefficient conclusion for every cubic string system is asserted by this audit.

proposed_bridge_obligation: For every partner order m coprime to three and every lower constant flow, prove that the normalized scalar order-(3,m) string coefficients reconstruct single-valuedly and meromorphically from an admitted universal rank-three spectral connection over every finite time, including resonant apparent poles and degenerate monodromy data. Check the formal type, absence of finite fixed singularities, and the gauge/normalization reconstruction. Meromorphic connection coefficients alone do not prove this.
current_scope: QSO34 and QSO35 have direct algebraic Puiseux proofs and do not depend on this all-order bridge. The audit does not claim that a modern general theorem is absent, or that Malgrange's 1982 question remains open today.
evidence: Internal primary-PDF inspection via web and local pypdf extraction; exact cached bytes pinned.
